signing.payload_encoding: Original UTF-8 bytes, no BOM; no reserialization before verification
signing.base64url: Unpadded; re-encode must exactly match supplied value
signing.key_roles: Issuer LICENSE/LEASE, REVOCATION, PACKAGE and TRUST keys are separate; role/environment/purpose allowlisted locally
signing.issuer_private_key: Issuer-only; never inside any client, repository, MCP tool, fixture delivery or customer machine

limits.all_durations: Proposed engineering defaults; no customer policy activated

serial.generation: CSPRNG 128 bits, unpadded Base32 uppercase -> 26 characters, prefix VIA-
serial.issuer_ledger: Unique constraint with retry; customer_ref + license_id + device_public_key_hash + state + sequence + audit event
serial.legacy_combo_serial: Display alias only; never proof of purchase or permission

verification_order: trusted kid + role + environment + Ed25519 signature over exact domain-separated bytes
signed package identity and bounded entitlement/product/features/release sequence
time validity and saved trusted-time anchor
latest trusted revocation sequence, expiry, revoked license/device/kid
license and lease monotonic sequence; same sequence requires byte-identical digest
local device key proof of possession
if ONLINE_LEASE verify correlated signed lease and nonce; lease expiry <= license expiry
emit scoped decision receipt; only ALLOW starts paid operation
semantics: Times UTC RFC3339 seconds Z; issued_at <= not_before < expires_at; now is accepted only when not_before <= now < expires_at. Offline expires_at - issued_at <= proposed offline cap.
Unique product_id across entitlements; unique normalized paths across package files; entrypoint must be in files; package release_sequence must not exceed matching entitlement maximum.

Revocation snapshot valid_until > now and sequence >= saved high-water mark and minimum_revocation_sequence; imported lower sequence rejected. Same sequence with different bytes rejected. Deny both revoked license and device and signer.
Lease matches license_id, license_sequence, device hash, environment and request nonce; issued/expires within license; duration <= signed max_lease_seconds; a nonce is used once at issuer.

Device binding is SHA256 of DER SPKI for a locally held CNG ECDSA P-256 key. Runtime challenge is 32 random bytes, signed with ECDSA SHA256; signature transport is fixed 64-byte r||s, no ambiguous DER signature format.

TPM_NONEXPORTABLE must be attested/verified by issuer before granting that protection tier; caller assertion alone is insufficient. SOFTWARE_USER_KEY is visibly lower assurance. Machine hash / MAC alone is insufficient.

Trusted-time anchor and monotonic counters are atomically persisted; missing or corrupted protected state requires revalidation. A local administrator or full VM rollback cannot be perfectly resisted offline.

Expired or stale license stops NEW paid jobs; current job ends at documented safe checkpoint. Read-only diagnosis and export of already-owned data remain accessible; no erase, encryption or peer process kill.

Revoke offline licenses at next signed snapshot import or bounded expiration. No promise of immediate revocation without communication. Online lease bounds outage/revocation delay; offline recovery never silently bypasses validation.

Client package manifest must reject absolute/UNC/drive/ADS/.. paths, links/junctions, Windows reserved names, case collisions, extra executable content and missing files. A hash without trusted signature is not publisher authentication.

Normal updates cannot decrease release_sequence. Rollback must reference a prior verified manifest and allowed rollback sequence, remain within current entitlement and revocation policy; database restore uses copy-on-write checkpoint.

Trust rotation is threshold-authorized by current offline root and new root; test/production roots are separate. If root compromise cannot be authenticated in-band, require separately approved recovery installer. No TRUST endpoint implemented in this review.

activate.auth: Single-use code delivered out of band; hashed at rest; never serial only

renew.auth: device-signed server nonce and current license
renew.transaction: unique request_id plus atomic seat ledger; identical retry returns same result

revoke.audit: reason + actor + time + monotonic sequence; immutable audit

online_api_proposal.transfer: Retire old seat; issue new device-bound certificate; preserve both audit events; no guarantee old offline device stops immediately

scope_note: This is a reviewable protocol specification and schemas, not an issued license, activation client, enforcement SDK or production service.
